title: EventLens AI
description: Financial risk analytics that combines news signals with market data, then estimates portfolio exposure with Value-at-Risk and Monte Carlo projections.
contribution: Built the ETL pipeline and Random Forest workflow across 250+ GDELT event-days; delivered analysis through FastAPI services and a React dashboard.
keyDecision: Join event sentiment and volatility with live market prices before modeling abnormal returns.

diagramCaption: Project architecture · built during IBM internship

title: Hireloop: AI Job Copilot
description: An AI job copilot that parses a resume into a structured profile, ranks jobs from public ATS APIs, and tailors each resume using facts from that profile.
contribution: Designing the end-to-end product, hybrid retrieval pipeline, and LangGraph workflow with human approval and a faithfulness verifier.
keyDecision: Ground generated resume claims in structured profile facts, then flag unsupported content for review.
diagramAlt: Illustrative Hireloop job-matching workflow, not a product screenshot

title: Customer Churn MLOps
description: XGBoost with SMOTE reaches 0.82 AUC-ROC on 7,032 Telco customers. T-learner uplift modeling identifies persuadable customers, reducing simulated campaign spend by 56%.
contribution: Built the churn model, uplift segments, SHAP explanations, FastAPI prediction API, and Streamlit dashboard; tracked experiments in MLflow.
keyDecision: Target customers by estimated response to an offer, not churn risk alone.

metric.label: lower simulated retention spend with uplift targeting

title: Proactive Academic Intervention System
description: A hybrid student-risk model scores 5,000 records, reaching 0.887 ROC-AUC, 0.764 F1, and 79.9% recall for at-risk students.
contribution: Engineered four derived features and six DSA modules; helped deploy the Flask application on Render.
keyDecision: Blend model predictions with rule-based signals (70/30) to combine statistical risk with explicit domain rules.
